\textbf{Foundation-model attention against its uniform-attention null.} (a) Median over TFs of the overlap between the 50 top-ranked targets by attention and by the $1/L$ null (the attention an edge would receive if each cell spread attention uniformly over its $L$ input genes); filled: raw attention, hatched: transposed and normalised variants; black ticks: overlap expected for a random ranking. The 50 top targets of raw scGPT attention overlap with those of its null by 0.42--0.48 (random ranking 0.03--0.05), those of raw Geneformer attention by 0.08--0.16. (b) TF-matched held-out enrichment of each model's top-50-per-TF predicted set divided by that of its own $1/L$ null, with paired 95\% TF-cluster bootstrap intervals (reference line at 1; triangles mark lower limits below the axis range; open markers: references flagged as low support).
